plan.goal: Critique and validate the end-to-end UX of the Climate Almanac data-explorer, focusing on the primary variable-to-chart-to-inspector interaction and the adjacent flows (sharing, downloading, and navigation).
plan.summary: Run begins on index.html and exercises the core loop: add/remove overlay variables, change region/smoothing/y-axis mode, and verify that hovering the chart updates the right-rail inspector consistently. Then validate secondary controls: annotations (pinned notes and close controls), zoom/reset, ordering via drag, and finally Share view and Download .csv. Complete coverage by repeating critical checks on mobile viewport.
assumptions: The app is contained in a single HTML file (index.html) with all key flows accessible there; no other pages were prescanned.
Hovering the chart drives both the tooltip and the Inspector panel as stated in the visible text.
Share view and Download .csv are functional buttons in the top bar on index.html.
Variable selection uses checkboxes in the left rail and supports a drag-to-reorder interaction for the active layers.
risk_hotspots: Variable layer checkboxes (ux-8..ux-13): very small tap targets (13x13) and potential discoverability/activation issues on mobile
Share view button (ux-6) and Download .csv button (ux-7): risk of non-obvious behavior, blocked popups/downloads, or missing state serialization
Drag-to-reorder layers control (LAYERS DRAG TO REORDER): risk of broken drag handling or mismatch between visual order and exported/share state
Chart interaction: hover tooltip + Inspector sync (stated: hovering updates inspector values for the same year)
Zoom/Reset zoom and + Note interactions (ux-24, ux-25) and annotation close buttons (× on pins): risk of state loss or overlay persistence bugs
Annotations/pinned notes with dismiss (e.g., the 1945/1991/2015 cards): verify dismissal doesn’t break layout or inspector mapping

phases.title: Establish primary interaction loop (desktop)
phases.objective: Confirm that the variable selection and chart hover interaction work as designed and that the right-rail inspector reflects the hovered year consistently.
key_checks: With default selected layers, hover multiple distinct years on the chart and verify the tooltip year/value and Inspector values update in sync

Toggle variable checkboxes on/off one at a time (Surface temperature anomaly, Precipitation, Atmospheric CO₂, Global mean sea level, Arctic sea-ice extent, ENSO index) and validate the chart series visibility and legend/labels
Add up to 4 layers (as UI promises) and verify readability/scale handling remains stable
exit_criteria: Hovering across at least 3 different years updates tooltip and Inspector consistently
At least 3 variable toggles are validated with visible chart changes and no UI errors
A 4-layer overlay scenario is reached and remains interactive

phases.title: Validate configuration controls (region, smoothing, y-axis)
phases.objective: Ensure that dropdowns/radios correctly recompute chart rendering and that y-axis mode changes affect labeling/scale as expected.
key_checks: Change REGION via the dropdown (Global → Northern Hemisphere → Southern Hemisphere → Tropics → Arctic) and verify chart updates without breaking hover/tooltips
Change SMOOTHING (No smoothing, 3-year, 10-year, 30-year normal) and verify the chart shape changes and Inspector hover still maps to the same year system
Toggle Y-AXIS between Dual axes and Single (z-scored) and verify axis/scale behavior is consistent with the labeling (e.g., absolute vs unit-less)
exit_criteria: All dropdown/radio options are exercised at least once
After each option change, hovering still updates the Inspector correctly
No visual overlap or missing series occurs after y-axis mode switches

phases.title: Layer ordering, zoom, notes, and annotations
phases.objective: Test stateful interactions that can change rendering order or add persistent UI elements, including error-prone dismissal and reset behaviors.
key_checks: Use drag-to-reorder in the LAYERS area to change layer order; verify chart legend/stack order and that hover values still correspond to the correct series
Use + Note (ux-25) to add at least one note; verify the note appears in Annotations area and remains visible after subsequent hover/setting changes
Use the × close control on pinned annotations (e.g., ux-18 shown) and verify the note is removed and layout remains intact
Test zoom controls: apply zoom (e.g., via chart interaction) then click Reset zoom (ux-24); verify chart returns to full range and hover/Inspector mapping works again
exit_criteria: At least one drag reorder is validated with correct hover/series association
A note can be added and dismissed without breaking the inspector or chart
Zoom then Reset zoom returns the chart to baseline and hover mapping remains correct

phases.title: Secondary actions: Share view and Download .csv (desktop)
phases.objective: Validate whether share/download reflect the current explorer state (selected layers, region, smoothing, y-axis, and ordering) and can be used without errors.
key_checks: Click Share view (ux-6) and verify the expected share UI/behavior appears (e.g., link/copy) and includes current configuration
Change the explorer state (e.g., toggle one variable and switch smoothing) then share again to confirm the shared state differs appropriately
Click Download .csv (ux-7) and verify the download starts and contains columns/rows consistent with currently selected variables and year range shown in the chart header
exit_criteria: Share view produces a usable output (link or copy) tied to the current configuration
At least one CSV download is generated and inspected for schema alignment with active layers

phases.title: Mobile critical path validation
phases.objective: Re-run the highest-impact checks on a mobile viewport, emphasizing small tap targets and chart/side-rail interactions.
key_checks: Repeat variable toggle + hover sync validation (from Phase 1) to ensure interaction remains possible with small checkbox targets
Verify scroll/access to Inspector and Annotations panels and that chart hover (or equivalent touch interaction) updates values
Test Share view and Download .csv tap targets are reachable and actions succeed on mobile
exit_criteria: Core loop (select variable(s) → chart inspect → inspector updates) works on mobile
Share view and Download .csv can be triggered successfully on mobile without UI trapping

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages (only index.html from prescan)
coverage_targets.features: exercise most visible controls per key page: all variable checkboxes, REGION dropdown, SMOOTHING dropdown, Y-AXIS radios, drag-to-reorder, Reset zoom, + Note, annotation dismiss, Share view, and Download .csv
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks on mobile viewport for: variable toggles + chart hover/inspector sync, access to inspector/annotations, and Share/Download actions

notes: Prescan shows only index.html, so navigation links (Datasets/Stories/Methods/About) are not assumed to open new pages; only validate their actual click behavior if they navigate or change content within the same page.
Given the prescan layout warnings, prioritize tap-target usability checks specifically for variable checkboxes and top-bar buttons on mobile.
